title: Mushroom sauce for steak - with cream
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
small onion
140g
mushrooms , quartered
2
thyme sprigs, leaves removed
100ml
double cream
1
large teaspoon wholegrain mustard

2
thyme sprigs, leaves removed
100ml
double cream
1
large teaspoon wholegrain mustard

Method:-
Fry the steaks as normal in a pan. Remove and set aside
Add the mushrooms and thyme leaves to the pan, then cook for a couple of mins until softened and golden.
Stir in the double cream and mustard
Allow to bubble for 1 minute
Season.
Serve the steaks with the mushroom sauce poured over.
